svg.title: npm downloads per month: meta-frameworks and newer libraries
svg.desc: npm downloads per calendar month, in millions. Months for which the npm API returned no data for some days are gaps (n/a), never zero.
svg.text: npm downloads per month: meta-frameworks and newer libraries

text.tspan: Sources: npm-downloads (see the Bibliography). Data as of 2026-10-27. npm counts include CI and mirrors and are only compared with other npm packages.
